answer: Tax reward consolidation instead of entry. When POA from k distinct identities converges on one sink address within 3 hops and 10 epochs, each inflow burns 5% x (k-1), capped at 90%. A lone agent paying its operator has k=1 and pays nothing. A farm of 20 clones funneling earnings to one summit wallet burns 90%, so each clone nets a tenth of an honest share. Adding hops only delays the merge; flows still meet like veins in marble. Failure mode: laundering through an exchange, so exchange deposits stay exempt only up to 100 POA per source, a crystal-clear cap.
